reviews.comment: Dr. Vedenov is by far the best teacher I’ve had at A&M- not because he’s funny or flashy, but because he knows how to TEACH. Surprisingly, most professors don’t know how to do that. His AGEC 448 class is very slow-paced and straightforward. If you get anything less than a B, it is 100% your fault.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Excellently laid out course. Professor was motivated and passionate.

I loved this class because he made it interesting!! The iclicker questions helped so much with learning the material. He was an easy grader for homework's. He responds very fast outside of class and will help you with anything. I truly enjoyed coming to class, but If I couldn't come then he records the lectures for us to watch later.
